tools.name: calculate_melt_value
tools.description: Precious-metal melt value, fine content, unit rates and optional buyer-offer comparison from metal, purity, weight and construction. Includes current website quotes and a prefilled PDF-report link. Custom spot prices and mixed worksheets are supported.

tools.name: calculate_coin_value
tools.description: Coin melt value and fine-metal content from a native coin issue, quantity or standard rolls, and optional measured total grams. Includes current website quotes, optional buyer-offer comparison and a prefilled PDF-report link.

tools.name: find_coins
tools.description: Native precious-metal coin presets with issue years, images, metal specifications and current melt value per coin, filtered by name or metal.

tools.name: get_coin
tools.description: A native precious-metal coin preset with issue years, image, specifications and a quantity-one melt calculation at the current website quote.

tools.name: calculate_exchange
tools.description: Gold-to-silver or silver-to-gold exchange weight at current website quotes, including sale discount, purchase premium and fees. Includes a prefilled PDF-report link.

tools.name: calculate_penny_nickel
tools.description: Penny or nickel alloy metal value from count or measured total grams and explicit manual base-metal prices in USD per ordinary pound. Includes constituent weights, face value and a prefilled PDF-report link.
